Staging installs beside the real app as Easyday Staging with an amber icon and its own data, so a try-out never touches your history.

If Android asks

  1. Chrome may say the file could be harmful. Tap Download anyway: it is your own build, signed with a debug key.
  2. Opening the APK the first time asks to allow installs from Chrome. Allow it and go back.
  3. Updating keeps your data: the package id stays app.easyday, so each new APK installs over the old one.
